accepted_risks.detail: /metrics, /docs, /openapi.json, /redoc are reachable without credentials (endpoint-inventory + metrics-list disclosure; synthetic READ context confined to exact exempt paths). Explicitly ACCEPTED as low / non-blocking by SECURITY-REVERIFY-4 (t_976bba61); optional hardening recommended (disable docs in prod / auth or separate port for /metrics).

MVP-shell frontend (frontend/src/mvp/, ~10 files incl. App.mvp.test.tsx) is out-of-scope for MVP v1, excluded from vitest/tsc collection by design; deferred and tracked by card t_452ee514 (deliberately excluded, not deleted).

agent-management/agent_management/crypto.py _get_kek() has a dev fallback (hard-coded salt) with no production guard - fail-open when AUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset. Documented dev-only; recommended: refuse to start in prod without the key. Non-blocking (REVIEW-VERIFY-2).

quality-gates release approve/reject is gated by require_write, not require_admin (governance/irreversible action); inconsistent with runtime-hardening where DELETE requires admin. Observation, no approved spec mandates admin. Non-blocking (REVIEW-VERIFY-2).

WebSocket API key travels in the query string (?api_key=) - can leak into proxy access logs / browser history / Referer. Prefer Sub-WebSocket-Protocol carrier or short-lived signed ticket in production. Non-blocking (REVIEW-VERIFY-2).
TLSRedirectMiddleware.trust_proxy=True by default honors client-supplied X-Forwarded-Proto. Redirection is not a security control (HSTS is), so impact is low. Non-blocking (REVIEW-VERIFY-2).

3 pre-existing mypy arg-type errors in shared/security_middleware.py:116,124 and runtime/api.py:464 (add_middleware typing vs Starlette). Present at base, untouched by REWORK-3, codegen-neutral. Non-blocking.
No dependency-vulnerability scanner (pip-audit) installed in the venv; dependency review done via manifest-delta (zero new dependencies in the REWORK-3 diff). Residual tooling limitation.

release_notes.summary: MVP v1 release candidate preparation for commit fd3cb4e (branch integration/mvp-v1). All three mandatory quality gates are VERIFIED for this exact candidate: TESTER PASS (t_9b341e7e), REVIEWER APPROVED (t_e0105ed1), SECURITY PASS (t_976bba61), and the candidate identity/working tree is verified. Status is READY by gates, but HUMAN APPROVAL HAS NOT BEEN OBTAINED and release readiness is conditional on two open human decisions (branch completeness; unified MVP version). No release bundle was built, pushed, tagged, published or deployed; human approval and separately authorized execution remain required.
changes: Authenticated the previously unauthenticated WebSocket /agents/{agent_id}/events in runtime-hardening (commit fd3cb4e): API key supplied via the ?api_key= query parameter and validated before websocket.accept() using shared.auth_middleware.resolve_api_key_roles; unauthenticated/invalid-key connections are rejected at handshake with no state byte streamed (read-equivalent role, mirroring GET /agents/{id}).
Role-based HTTP authorization (Depends(require_read/write/admin)) enforced across agent-management, orchestration-server, quality-gates and runtime-hardening routes (commit fd3aa3b).
SEC-002 TLS/HSTS configuration and SEC-004 auth_config envelope encryption implemented on the integration branch (commits ed39b97/63a6bb8 and bac9f40).
fixes: SEC-001 HTTP role-based authorization: verified via live 401/403/pass probes (SECURITY-REPORT-fd3cb4e.md, SECURITY-REPORT-fd3aa3b.md).

SEC-001-WS unauthenticated WebSocket: FIXED at fd3cb4e and independently verified (no/bad key -> HTTP 403 at handshake, zero state bytes; read/write/admin connect and stream {"type":"state",...}); final blocking item from REVERIFY-3, now closed.
SEC-002 TLS/HSTS, SEC-003 deny-by-default tool policy, SEC-004 auth_config encryption: verified green (18/10/15 tests).
Prior-gate regressions confirmed closed on fd3cb4e: encryption tests 15 passed, ResizeObserver polyfill present, frontend typecheck exit 0.
configuration: AUTH_ENABLED must be true for role-based authorization and WebSocket authentication to apply. When AUTH_ENABLED=false (dev), keyless behavior is preserved.
WebSocket clients must supply the API key via the ?api_key= query parameter (browsers cannot set custom WebSocket handshake headers).
TLS requires cert_file/key_file (per-service env prefixes ORCH_ / AGENT_MGMT_ / AGENT_RUNTIME_ / QG_); HSTS is emitted only when TLS is enabled.
